notes: One ticket per fix. `check` must be machine-decidable or typed `manual`. `basis` must point at the reference section that justifies the ticket - a ticket nobody can trace to a criterion is an opinion.

tickets.title: Unblock AI crawlers in robots.txt
tickets.basis: references/four-layer-model.md - access layer; nothing downstream is visible while this fails
tickets.acceptance: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot are allowed at / by RFC 9309 group semantics

tickets.title: Stop the WAF from answering 403 to AI crawlers
tickets.basis: references/four-layer-model.md - robots permission is not edge permission
tickets.acceptance: GPTBot receives the same page a browser receives (status and body size within 60%)

tickets.title: Server-render the Hebrew landing page
tickets.basis: references/content-blocks.md - crawlers that do not execute JS see an empty shell
tickets.acceptance: Static HTML of the Hebrew page contains at least 1000 words of body text

tickets.title: Publish Organization JSON-LD with sameAs
tickets.acceptance: Organization JSON-LD present on the home page

tickets.title: Add a definition block to the Hebrew service page
tickets.basis: references/content-blocks.md - definition block, highest single lever
tickets.acceptance: Hebrew definition pattern detected on the page

tickets.title: Rewrite three sections into self-contained evidence passages
tickets.basis: references/content-blocks.md - retrieval selects passages, not pages
tickets.acceptance: At least 3 quotable passages on the page

tickets.title: Ship llms.txt with working links
tickets.acceptance: llms.txt exists, is structurally valid, and every listed link resolves and is crawlable

tickets.title: Get the brand listed in the relevant Israeli directory
tickets.basis: references/priority-and-risk.md - external sources outrank further home-page polish
tickets.acceptance: Listing is live and shows the canonical brand name and URL

params.note: Confirm the listing URL, then set status manually. Record the URL in history.
